purpose: Form NCLT-18 is used to maintain a register for appeals and petitions against the orders of the Tribunal to the National Company Law Appellate Tribunal.
when: In the first week of every month for scrutiny
steps: Maintain a register in Form NCLT-18 for appeals and petitions.
Make necessary entries promptly in the register by the judicial branch.
Place the register for scrutiny by the President in the first week of every month.
checklist: Ensure Form NCLT-18 register is maintained for appeals and petitions
Confirm necessary entries are made promptly by the judicial branch
Prepare the register for scrutiny in the first week of every month
watch: Ensure the register is placed for scrutiny by the President in the first week of every month.
